verdict.rationale: The evidence pack includes material from Ollama's own GitHub repository (github.com/ollama/ollama), which suggests the source is publicly readable. However, no item states what license that source is released under, so the 'open license' part of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an open-source license (e.g. MIT/Apache text or a license statement), first-party docs pointing to the source code, and independent corroboration of the licensing terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
